column3:
A lone swordsman on his own path.
His three-hit combo advances forward.
He launches foes with an upward slash
and strikes down with a diving slash.

She runs fast and strikes even faster.
Her five-hit combo works on the ground
and in midair. Each hit is light,
but her speed makes up for it.

Her greatsword hits hard. Beyond 20 km,
her power and reach keep growing.
Enemy hits cannot interrupt
her attacks.
She fires forward, back, or diagonally\nup or down. Downshots slow her fall.\nEach narrow bullet hits only one foe.

His long spear pierces lined-up foes
with heavy damage and knockback.
But enemies too close to him
are hard to hit.

Waiting after any shot strengthens
his next forward arrow. At full charge,
it pierces foes. Rapid fire is weak;
taking damage resets the charge.

She floats above the ground and gaps.
Changing height casts a spell.
Her HP is low, and enemy hits
knock her back farther.

His short-range combo ends in a
powerful fourth hit. A timed back
stance counters enemy attacks safely,
but cannot stop falls or hazards.

She dashes through foes with a slash.
Her dash grants brief invulnerability,
but her low maximum HP leaves
little room for mistakes.

Her talismans explode after a delay;
a second triggers a bigger blast.
Her barrier slows regular foes,
and her shikigami attacks behind.

Hits fill his blood gauge, boosting
power and speed. At full gauge, he gets
a five-second boost and can heal.
It drains when he stops hitting
or is hit on the ground.

She sweeps foes with claws, tail,
and flame. She can jump high and glide.
Her large body is easy to hit,
but she has high HP and resists knockback.

A brave little tabby with quick paws
and fearless pounces. His small body
slips past danger, and he jumps high.
No weapons or armor needed.

Its arms and legs stretch far.
Stomping a foe in midair makes it bounce
up once per jump. No one knows
where this fluffy visitor came from.
